summary: Remove the unused residency inventory projection

replay.detail: Residency events, transitions, generation fences and native resume behavior are unchanged.

schema.detail: The ledger and runtime residency serialization, validation and stored schema are unchanged. No caller serializes the removed projection in this repository.

rules.detail: Only the uncalled InventoryProjection, Ledger::inventory_projection and its sole RuntimeResidency::as_str helper are removed. All retained production code and tests remain byte-identical.

compatibility.detail: Removes one unused workspace Rust type and two methods. Unknown external source consumers are not claimed absent and must remove any use. No published client, wire, CLI or stored-format contract changes.

downtime.detail: No restart required for removal of uncalled code.

manual.detail: No operator action or ledger cleanup required.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the projection without changing stored state.
